Hi Alicia & team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about Novapulse's ingestion patterns and the upcoming pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a short product walkthrough scheduled (30 minutes, focused on integration and performance):

What I heard:
- You want low-latency embeddings and predictable cost under burst traffic.
- Pilot target: ingest ~30k docs/day, real-time query latency target ~200ms median.
- Security: you want clarification on data residency and SSO options before pilot.

Proposed next step: 30-minute walkthrough (product + 10min Q&A) with your engineering/infra lead present. Please pick one of these narrow windows (all in PST):
1) Tue Dec 7 — 10:00–10:30 AM
2) Wed Dec 8 — 2:30–3:00 PM
3) Thu Dec 9 — 11:00–11:30 AM

If none work, suggest two windows that suit your tech owner. Also please confirm the engineering contact who should join (name + email).

I've attached a short agenda and a pre-demo checklist (sample dataset format, expected SSO matrix) to help your team prepare. If you prefer I can send a calendar poll instead.

Quick asks for the session:
- Engineering owner (for integration discussion)
- A sample of query size distribution (if available) or a rough QPS estimate

Thanks — I can coordinate the invite once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
